objective: Remove the rejected empty vamp volume while closing both terminal tunnels and preserving the V6.1 interface, approved collar, and visible outer planform.

manufacturing_tradeoff.reason: The required solid 8 mm heel and toe plugs add deposited material even though the unnecessary midfoot envelope volume is reduced.
manufacturing_tradeoff.decision: Accept the local material increase because fully closed terminal zones are an approved functional constraint; do not relax wall or closure requirements for nominal material savings.

mesh_simplification.reason: All meshes stay below the declared 600000-triangle and 30 MiB stops, and the finer tessellation is required to hold the 1.25 mm visible-edge limit. No exact slicer baseline exists to justify lossy decimation.

slicer_resolution_check.reason: Exact Anycubic machine, process, TPU filament, and orientation profiles remain unresolved.

decision: The geometry change is Pareto-acceptable for the approved correction: less rejected free envelope volume and closed ends, with an explicit local material cost. Release optimization remains open until exact slicer A/B evidence exists.
limitations: Envelope integration is a deterministic geometric comparison, not a footwear pressure or comfort simulation.
CAD/mesh material volume is not a slicer mass or print-time result.
No strength, fatigue, comfort, or wear claim is made without process-matched physical evidence.
